localBiteReport: The week of September 18–24, 2026 is shaping up as one of the better early-fall inshore windows in recent memory around the Destin/Choctawhatchee Bay area. Redfish are the standout species, with slot fish and oversized reds spread from the East Pass into the main bay system; local guides are leaning on live scaled sardines, shrimp, and croakers fished around structure, with the bite heavily tide-dependent. Flounder and speckled trout are also showing up alongside the reds, and an abundance of bait moving through the bay is credited with fueling that broader inshore improvement. Water temp today is 86°F. Note that flounder harvest closes October 15, so the next few weeks are a good window to target them before the closure.
